lines.en: label sadgirls1:
scene black
Yasu sets her sights on someone who, up to this point, has managed to stay relatively uninvolved with the chaotic happenings of the morning and urgently makes her way over to her.
lines.zh: Yasu 把目光锁定在了一个人身上——那个人直到此刻还算成功地避开了今早这一连串混乱——然后急匆匆地朝她走了过去。

lines.en: Caught up in the clamor, the rest of the girls do not see it.
lines.zh: 被喧闹声裹挟着,其他女孩并没有看见这一幕。

lines.en: But it is the {i}only{/i} thing I see.
lines.zh: 但这是我{i}唯一{/i}看得见的东西。

lines.en: I don’t know if the whispers of the world find their way into {i}my{/i} ears as well or if I have just placed a large stake of momentary faith in Yasu-
lines.zh: 我不知道世界的低语是不是也钻进了{i}我耳朵{/i}里,还是说我只是在 Yasu 身上押下了大得离谱的一笔信任——

lines.en: But I keep my eyes and ears focused.
lines.zh: 但我让自己的眼睛和耳朵始终保持着专注。

lines.en: For the chances of what happens next being positive in nature seem impossible.
lines.zh: 因为接下来要发生的事,看起来根本不可能是什么好事。

lines.en: And the idea of great misfortune befalling someone who already washes down each meal with it seems too sad to be true.
lines.zh: 而要让一个已经把不幸就着每一餐咽下去的人再遭一场大祸,这实在太残忍,残忍到不像是真的。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves1
: Can I...help you, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 我……能帮你什么吗,Yasu?

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉。

lines.en: : Sorry for what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 到底抱歉什么?

lines.en: : You don’t think this was your fault, do you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会觉得这是你的错吧?

lines.en: : Fights are an inevitable aspect of high school life and it’s surprising we’ve managed to make it this far without having experienced one yet.
lines.zh: : 打架是高中生活不可避免的一部分,我们能撑到现在还没经历过一次,反而挺让人意外的。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry too much about it. It’s-
lines.zh: : 我劝你别太放在心上。这件事——

lines.en: : I’m sorry for what comes next.
lines.zh: : 我为接下来要发生的事感到抱歉。

lines.en: : For what...comes next?
lines.zh: : 接下来……要发生什么?

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves2
Yasu returns to her seat, leaving Makoto mildly perplexed, but mostly unfazed.
lines.zh: Yasu 回到自己的座位上,留下一头雾水的 Makoto——不过她基本上没当回事。

lines.en: That’s just the way people hear Yasu’s words now.
lines.zh: 如今大家就是这么听 Yasu 说话的。

lines.en: She’s spent too long allowing innate fanaticism to dribble out of her mouth that we’ve already deemed it pointless to lend her our handkerchiefs.
lines.zh: 她花了太长时间让骨子里的狂热从嘴里一路淌出来,我们早就觉得,再递手帕给她擦已经是白费力气。

lines.en: Which is why what happens next still comes as a surprise to Makoto.
lines.zh: 也正因如此,接下来发生的事还是让 Makoto 吃了一惊。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves3
: Makoto Miyamura, please come to the front office immediately.
lines.zh: : Makoto Miyamura,请立刻到办公室来一趟。

lines.en: : I repeat: Makoto Miyamura, please come to the front office immediately.
lines.zh: : 重复一遍:Makoto Miyamura,请立刻到办公室来一趟。

lines.en: : The front office? Me? Why?
lines.zh: : 办公室?我?为什么?

lines.en: : I knew it! You’ve been cheating on all of our exams the whole time, haven’t you?! There’s no way one person can be that smart!
lines.zh: : 我就知道!你一直在我们所有考试里作弊,对吧?!一个人不可能聪明到那种程度!

lines.en: : Wait a sec, there ain’t a second Makoto Miyamura in our school, is there? Cause I know {i}my{/i} Makoto wouldn’t ever get called to the office.
lines.zh: : 等等,我们学校里不会有第二个 Makoto Miyamura 吧?因为{i}我认识{/i}的这个 Makoto 是绝对不会被叫去办公室的。

lines.en: : Maybe Makoto’s just a rebel and none of us knew about it?
lines.zh: : 说不定 Makoto 其实是个叛逆少女,只是我们谁都不知道?

lines.en: : Or maybe she’s got a secret part time job that the school found out about? I remember seeing something in the handbook about how that's not allowed.
lines.zh: : 或者她偷偷打了份零工被学校发现了?我记得学生手册里写过这种事是不允许的。

lines.en: : Did you seriously read the fucking handbook? Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你还真他妈读了那本手册啊?你到底是谁啊?

lines.en: : Uhhh...nope! She ain’t got anything like that! Definitely a good girl who focuses on her studies and doesn’t have any sorta job at all! Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 呃……没有!她才没干那种事!绝对是个专心学习、一份兼职都没有的好姑娘!哈哈哈哈!

lines.en: scene black
Makoto stares up at the speaker in the corner of the classroom, hoping for some added explanation or clarification as to why she’s suddenly being forced out of her comfort zone.
lines.zh: Makoto 抬头盯着教室角落里的广播,盼着它能再多解释两句,告诉她为什么突然被从舒适区里拽了出来。

lines.en: When she realizes no such thing is coming, she hesitantly slides her chair out from beneath her desk and slowly walks to the front of the room.
lines.zh: 当她明白不会有这种解释时,她犹豫着把椅子从课桌下拖出来,慢慢走向教室前面。

lines.en: But she stops in front of me, as if I can provide some sort of guidance when we’re all caught in the same storm and can’t even figure out which way is north.
lines.zh: 但她在我面前停下了,仿佛我能给她什么指引似的——尽管我们所有人都困在同一场风暴里,连哪边是北都分不清。

lines.en: I wish I could tell her where to go.
lines.zh: 我真希望能告诉她该往哪儿走。

lines.en: I just have no idea what it is she has to avoid just yet.
lines.zh: 只是我还不知道她到底该避开什么。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves4
: I take it you haven’t heard anything about this, have you?
lines.zh: : 你应该没听说过什么事吧?

lines.en: : Me? No clue. My plan for today was to just hide in my office. And seeing as {i}you’re{/i} the one who delivers the vast majority of my news to me, the chances of me knowing anything are pretty slim.
lines.zh: : 我?一无所知。我今天本来打算就窝在我的办公室里。再说了,我的消息绝大多数都是{i}你{/i}带给我的,我知情的机会相当渺茫。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves5
: You don’t think it could be your family’s store, do you? Noriko was just sayin’ that her last school-
lines.zh: : 你觉不可能是你家店里的事吧?Noriko 刚才还说她上一所学校——

lines.en: : I suppose it {i}could{/i} be. But I don’t understand why the PA would need to be used when standard protocol is to have the student’s homeroom teacher inform them of a mandatory meeting.
lines.zh: : 我想是有{i}可能{/i}。但按规矩,遇到必须出席的会面应该由班主任通知学生,我不明白为什么非得用广播。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...I don’t think anybody else’s job has ever involved this many wieners.
lines.zh: : 是啦,不过……我可不觉得还有谁的工作会跟这么多香肠打交道。

lines.en: : That is...a fair point. There are certainly an excess of those at the shop.
lines.zh: : 这……说得也有道理。店里那种东西确实多得过头。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves6
: Regardless, I suppose I should get a move on. If I actually {i}am{/i} in trouble, it wouldn’t be right to keep the office waiting.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样,我想我该动身了。要{i}是{/i}我真惹上麻烦了,让办公室的人干等着也不太好。

lines.en: : I’m sure it's just some sort of mix-up.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定只是哪里弄错了。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves7
: Either that or I’m finally being rewarded for my continued efforts and announcing as much over the intercom would have painted a target on my back.
lines.zh: : 要么就是我长久以来的努力终于得到回报了,而这种事要是在广播里宣布,等于在我背上画了个靶子。

lines.en: : Uhh...Makoto? Mind watchin' yourself a little? You’re elbowin’ where my boob's supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 呃……Makoto?你稍微注意点行吗?你手肘顶到的地方,本来该是我的胸来着。

lines.en: : I guess...let me know if you wind up needing anything.
lines.zh: : 那……要是你最后真需要什么,就跟我说。

lines.en: : Or if this involves me in any sort of way.
lines.zh: : 或者这事跟我有什么关联的话。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves8
: Whatever it is, leave it to me.
lines.zh: : 不管是什么,交给我。

lines.en: : There’s no problem Makoto Miyamura can’t handle.
lines.zh: : 没有 Makoto Miyamura 解决不了的问题。

lines.en: : There are plenty of problems Makoto Miyamura can’t handle. I know this because I am one of them.
lines.zh: : Makoto Miyamura 解决不了的问题多得是。我之所以知道,是因为我自己就是其中一个。

lines.en: : Then...correction. There are no {i}school{/i} related problems that Makoto Miyamura can’t handle. So I suggest you let me deal with this on my own.
lines.zh: : 那……更正一下。跟{i}学校{/i}有关的问题,Makoto Miyamura 没有解决不了的。所以我建议你让我自己处理。

lines.en: : The morning’s proven to be exhausting enough already and I know you were looking to avoid confrontation today.
lines.zh: : 今天早上已经够累人的了,而且我知道你今天本来就想躲开一切冲突。

lines.en: : Fair enough. Good luck, I guess. I’ll just have Miku help me clean up any blood that Nodoka may have left behind.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。那……祝你好运吧。Nodoka 要是留下了什么血迹,我就让 Miku 帮我清理。

lines.en: : I, uhh...
: I ain’t...really a fan of that idea, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我……其实不太赞成这个主意,Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
Makoto leaves the room, but instead of grabbing a mop and a bottle of bleach, Miku quickly retreats to my side and grabs hold of my sleeve.
lines.zh: Makoto 离开了教室,可 Miku 并没有去拿拖把和漂白水,而是快步退到我身边,一把抓住了我的袖子。

lines.en: She’s the second girl to do that today.
lines.zh: 她是今天第二个这么做的女孩。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves9
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : I can’t really describe it, but it feels kinda like my stomach is doin’ flips. This sorta thing ain’t ever happened to Makoto before.
lines.zh: : 我也说不太清,就是觉得胃里一阵翻江倒海。这种事以前从没在 Makoto 身上发生过。

lines.en: : What if it’s somethin’ really bad? Like...worse than the whole family business thing.
lines.zh: : 万一是什么很糟糕的事呢?比如……比家里店铺那件事还糟。

lines.en: : Is there something you had in mind?
lines.zh: : 你心里想到什么了吗?

lines.en: : The only thing I can think of involves you too. And I can’t imagine they woulda let ya come to class like normal if that was the case.
lines.zh: : 我唯一能想到的,也跟你有关。而且要真是那样,我想他们不可能还让你像平常一样来上课。

lines.en: : Ya think maybe we should tail her? Just waitin’ around to-
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们要不要跟上去?就这么干等着——

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves10
The door swings open and Miku reflexively latches onto the skin of my arm rather than just my sleeve.
lines.zh: 门猛地被推开,Miku 条件反射地死死抓在我胳膊的皮肉上,而不再只是袖子。

lines.en: I understand why when I see who is in front of it.
lines.zh: 当我看清门前站着的是谁时,我明白了她为什么这么做。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves11
: {b}WHERE IS MAKOTO?!?!?!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}MAKOTO 在哪儿?!?!?!{/b}

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : What's Maki doing here?...
lines.zh: : Maki 来这儿干什么?……

lines.en: : What’s going on?...
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了?……

lines.en: : {b}WHERE IS SHE?!?!?{/b}
: She just got called down to the office a minute-
lines.zh: : 她一分钟前刚被叫去办公室——

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves12
: {b}STAY HERE! DON’T FOLLOW ME!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}待在这儿!别跟过来!{/b}

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves13
Maki slams the door on her way out, putting an abrupt end to the residual fight gossip and replacing it with a brand new flavor of misery.
lines.zh: Maki 摔门而去,戛然终结了残留的打架八卦,取而代之的是一种全新的痛苦。

lines.en: Miku’s grip grows stronger. I can feel the blood vessels beneath my skin rupturing as I attempt to uncover a means of calming her down.
lines.zh: Miku 抓得更紧了。我拼命想找个法子让她冷静下来,同时能感觉到皮下的血管正在破裂。

lines.en: Desperate, I look to Yasu of all people, hoping that there’s some new sort of premonition that will tell me when this will end.
lines.zh: 绝望之中,我居然把目光投向了 Yasu,盼着她能有某种新的预感,告诉我这一切什么时候才会结束。

lines.en: But she sits unmoving, staring out of the window, and listening to the whispers of the world as it sings the most unpleasant melody it can think of.
lines.zh: 可她一动不动地坐着,望着窗外,听着世界的低语——那世界正唱着它能想到的最令人难受的旋律。

lines.en: : I ain’t ever heard her yell before...
lines.zh: : 我从没听她那样吼过……

lines.en: : I don’t like this, Sensei...I don’t like this at all...
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这样,Sensei……我一点都不喜欢这样……

lines.en: : You’ve gotta go after ‘em...Waitin’ here ain’t gonna do anything...
lines.zh: : 你得去追她们……在这儿干等着什么用也没有……

lines.en: : If Makoto’s in trouble...she needs you to be there for her...
lines.zh: : 如果 Makoto 遇到麻烦了……她需要你陪在她身边……

lines.en: : She needs your help...
lines.zh: : 她需要你的帮助……

lines.en: But what help would {i}I{/i} be? Especially after Maki directly told me to not get involved in this.
lines.zh: 可{i}我{/i}又能帮上什么忙?尤其是在 Maki 亲口叫我别插手之后。

lines.en: Why doesn’t {i}Miku{/i} help?
lines.zh: 为什么不是 {i}Miku{/i} 去帮?

lines.en: Because she’s scared?
lines.zh: 因为她害怕?

lines.en: What if I’m scared too?
lines.zh: 要是我也会害怕呢?

lines.en: I’m not saying I am, but what if I was?
lines.zh: 我又没说我怕,可万一我怕呢?

lines.en: Why should {i}I{/i} be the one who’s forced to cast that aside?
lines.zh: 凭什么就非得是{i}我{/i}把这个丢到一边?

lines.en: Is it because I’ve been on this earth longer? Because even that is untrue at this point.
lines.zh: 是因为我在这世上活得更久吗?可到了现在,这一点甚至也不成立了。

lines.en: Is it because she looks up to me? Because she doesn’t. Not the way she used to.
lines.zh: 是因为她仰慕我吗?她没有。不再像从前那样了。

lines.en: She knows now just what kind of person I am. Which is why she’s forced to walk alone.
lines.zh: 她现在知道我是什么样的人了。所以她才不得不独自前行。

lines.en: Is it because I’m a stand-in for the person she wants to see the most?
lines.zh: 是因为我是她最想见的那个人替身吗?

lines.en: Because that-
lines.zh: 因为那——

lines.en: That one makes sense.
lines.zh: 这条说得通。

lines.en: And I guess it’s that sort of idea, the idea that someone {i}needs{/i} me, that makes me separate my skin from Miku and carry my ruptured blood vessels out into the hall.
lines.zh: 我想,大概正是这种「有人{i}需要{/i}我」的念头,让我把皮肉从 Miku 手里抽出来,带着我那些破裂的血管走进了走廊。

lines.en: scene hall_day
: Tell her that...whatever happened, her best friend’s here for her!
lines.zh: : 告诉她……不管发生了什么,她最好的朋友都站在她这边!

lines.en: : And that even if she did do somethin’ bad, I’ll always be on her side!
lines.zh: : 还有,就算她真的做了什么坏事,我也会永远站在她那边!

lines.en: : Tell her that, Sensei! Tell her that when ya see her!
lines.zh: : 就这么告诉她,Sensei!你见到她的时候就这么告诉她!

lines.en: scene black
I find a happy medium in an ocean of overwhelming sadness and settle on a state of motion somewhere between walking and running.
lines.zh: 我在一片铺天盖地的悲伤之海里找到了一个折中,把移动的姿态定在了走与跑之间。

lines.en: And while swim speeds would make more sense given the analogy, it’s hard to call what I’m doing “swimming” in any sense of the word.
lines.zh: 按这个比喻来说,用游泳的速度会更贴切,可我现在的样子,无论从哪个意义上都算不上「游泳」。

lines.en: Not when every step makes it feel as if the water in my lungs is rising.
lines.zh: 尤其是每迈一步,都让我觉得肺里的水在往上涨。

lines.en: Not when every room I peer into in hopes of finding her increases the pressure building up inside of my chest.
lines.zh: 尤其是我抱着希望往每一间教室里张望时,胸腔里积蓄的压力就又重一分。

lines.en: Not after how every lap I make around the school reinforces the idea that maybe she’s already left.
lines.zh: 尤其是在我绕着学校跑完一圈又一圈之后,「她可能已经走了」这个念头愈发坚定。

lines.en: That maybe I was too late.
lines.zh: 也许我来得太晚了。

lines.en: And that I should have just stayed in the classroom like I was told- because at least there are people I can comfort {i}there{/i}.
lines.zh: 也许我该乖乖待在教室里——起码在{i}那里{/i},还有我能安慰的人。

lines.en: I give up on the idea of being a hero as I have never believed in them in the first place.
lines.zh: 我放弃了当英雄这个念头,反正我从一开始就不相信英雄。

lines.en: But in the gap between the first and third floor, there is a space where the water doesn’t rise.
lines.zh: 但在一楼和三楼之间的那段空隙里,有一处水不会再上涨的地方。

lines.en: And in this dry spot, my feet revel in the sensation of the scraping of sand- regardless of the shards of seashells finding solace in the safety of my soles.
lines.zh: 在这块干爽的地方,我的脚尽情享受着沙子摩擦的触感——哪怕贝壳的碎片正安安稳稳地扎进我的脚底。

lines.en: With each step, I connect with the sea in a way I have seldom done before.
lines.zh: 每走一步,我都以一种前所未有的方式与这片海相连。

lines.en: And if I listen closely, I can hear the ocean pouring out from underneath a bathroom door.
lines.zh: 而如果我仔细听,就能听见海水正从一扇洗手间的门底下涌出来。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves14
: IT’S NOT TRUE!!!
lines.zh: : 这不是真的!!!

lines.en: : I DON’T BELIEVE IT!!!
lines.zh: : 我不相信!!!

lines.en: : HE WOULDN’T!!!
lines.zh: : 他不会的!!!

lines.en: : HE CAN’T!!!
lines.zh: : 他不可能!!!

lines.en: : NOT WITHOUT SAYING GOODBYE!!!
lines.zh: : 他不会连再见都不说一声就走!!!

lines.en: : Makoto...
lines.zh: : Makoto……

lines.en: : DADDY!!!
: DADDY ISN’T GONE!!!
lines.zh: : 爸爸没有走!!!

lines.en: : THEY’RE WRONG!!!
lines.zh: : 他们搞错了!!!

lines.en: : HE’S ON HIS WAY HOME! HE’S ON HIS WAY-
lines.zh: : 他正在回家的路上!他正在回来的路——

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves15
: Makoto, stop it! Yelling won’t bring him back!
lines.zh: : Makoto,别这样!再怎么喊也唤不回他!

lines.en: : But he’s...he’s not gone! He’s not!
lines.zh: : 可他……他没有走!他没有!

lines.en: : Makoto!
lines.zh: : Makoto!

lines.en: : He hasn’t seen my new uniform yet!
lines.zh: : 他还没见过我的新制服!

lines.en: : He hasn’t read my report card!
lines.zh: : 他还没看过我的成绩单!

lines.en: : I need him to be proud of me! I need him to be proud!
lines.zh: : 我需要他为我骄傲!我需要他为我骄傲!

lines.en: : Daddy!
lines.zh: : 爸爸!

lines.en: : Daddy isn’t dead!
lines.zh: : 爸爸没有死!

lines.en: A tidal wave crashes into me and forces me back.
lines.zh: 一股巨浪撞在我身上,把我推了回去。

lines.en: But as I turn around to watch it disappear along with the rest of the ocean, I’m reminded that this is all just a metaphor I’ve been using to make myself feel better.
lines.zh: 可当我转身看着它连同整片海洋一起消失时,我才想起来,这一切不过是我用来让自己好受些的比喻。

lines.en: And that the harsh reality is that I’ve just walked into a private conversation in which the lives of two people who mean something to me are violently dismantled.
lines.zh: 而残酷的现实是,我刚刚闯进了一场私密的对话,对话里两个对我而言重要的人,人生正被粗暴地拆得粉碎。

lines.en: But when I make an effort to leave, my shoes scuff the floor.
lines.zh: 可当我打算离开时,我的鞋在地板上蹭出了声响。

lines.en: And the abruptness of the sound makes it difficult for me to find another metaphor to cling to.
lines.zh: 这声突兀的响动让我再也找不到别的比喻可以抓住。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves16
: I told you not to follow me!
lines.zh: : 我说了别跟过来!

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to-
lines.zh: : 我不是故意的——

lines.en: : Leave! Get out!
lines.zh: : 走!出去!

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I didn’t know-
lines.zh: : 对不起。我不知道——

lines.en: : I said get out!
lines.zh: : 我让你出去!

lines.en: : You have nothing to do with this!
lines.zh: : 这事跟你没有关系!

lines.en: scene black
She’s right.
lines.zh: 她说得对。

lines.en: I have nothing to do with this.
lines.zh: 这事跟我没关系。

lines.en: Which is why I don’t have a problem with just walking away.
lines.zh: 所以我就这么走开也毫无问题。

lines.en: Which is why I don’t spend the next five minutes standing outside of a bathroom door in a hall I seldom visit.
lines.zh: 所以我没有在接下来的五分钟里,站在一条我很少踏足的走廊上、一扇洗手间的门外。

lines.en: Which is why I hear none of what comes next.
lines.zh: 所以接下来的一切我一句都没有听见。

lines.en: I’m already somewhere else.
lines.zh: 我早就到了别的地方。

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves17
: Hey! Hey! Listen to me!
lines.zh: : 嘿!嘿!听我说!

lines.en: : We’re going to get through this! Together! You and me!
lines.zh: : 我们一定能挺过去的!一起!就你和我!

lines.en: : I know it’s not what you want, but I’m right here! Okay?! I’m right here and I’m not going anywhere!
lines.zh: : 我知道这不是你想要的,可我就在这儿!好吗?!我就在这儿,哪儿也不去!

lines.en: : Mommy’s got you!
lines.zh: : 妈妈抱着你!

lines.en: : I’ll read your report cards. I won’t really know what they mean, but I’ll read them! Okay?
lines.zh: : 我会看你的成绩单。我不太看得懂上面写什么,但我会看的!好吗?

lines.en: : And...I’ll learn to sew! Or something! In case you ever rip your uniform!
lines.zh: : 还有……我会去学缝纫!或者别的什么!万一你把制服撕破了!

lines.en: : I’ll do whatever you need! And that includes being proud of you! Because it might not seem like it sometimes, but I am! I am so...{i}so{/i} proud of you.
lines.zh: : 你需要什么我都去做!包括为你骄傲!因为有时候也许看不出来,可我就是!我是那么……{i}那么{/i}为你骄傲。

lines.en: : I want my dad!
lines.zh: : 我要爸爸!

lines.en: : I want my daddy!
lines.zh: : 我要我的爸爸!

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves18
: I know, baby. I know you do. I want him too. But it’s just us now...and that’s okay!
lines.zh: : 我知道,宝贝。我知道你想。我也想他。可现在只剩我们俩了……这也没关系!

lines.en: : That’s okay because it’s been {i}just us{/i} for a few years anyway, and we’ve been doing great!
lines.zh: : 没关系的,反正这几年本来就一直是{i}我们俩{/i},而且我们过得很好!

lines.en: : I’m not saying things will be easy. This is going to be the hardest thing you’ll ever have to go through. But don’t think for a second that you’re alone.
lines.zh: : 我不是说以后会轻松。这将是你一生中最难熬的一件事。但哪怕一秒钟都别以为你是孤单一人。

lines.en: : We’re in this together. We can cry {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们一起面对。我们可以{i}一起哭{/i}。

lines.en: : We can miss him {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们可以{i}一起{/i}想他。

lines.en: : It’s too soon! I wasn’t ready!
lines.zh: : 太早了!我还没准备好!

lines.en: : I never got to say goodbye! I never got to say goodbye!
lines.zh: : 我还没来得及说再见!我还没来得及说再见!

lines.en: : We can still talk to him! And wherever he is, he’ll hear us! But for now, just...
lines.zh: : 我们还是可以跟他说话的!不管他在哪儿,都会听见我们!但现在,先……

lines.en: : Just rely on me, baby. Cry as much as you want and I’ll be right here to hold you tight.
lines.zh: : 就靠着我吧,宝贝。想哭就哭个够,我就在这儿紧紧抱着你。

lines.en: : Mom! Tell me it’s not real! Tell me this is all just a nightmare! And that when I wake up, Daddy will be home and we’ll all go on a big trip together!
lines.zh: : 妈妈!告诉我这不是真的!告诉我这只是一场噩梦!等我醒来,爸爸就会在家,我们一家人还能一起去旅行!

lines.en: : We can still go on a trip! You and me! Mother and daughter! To anywhere you want! Anywhere at all!
lines.zh: : 我们还是可以去旅行的!就你和我!母女俩!去你想去的任何地方!任何地方都行!

lines.en: : I want to see my dad!
lines.zh: : 我要见我爸爸!

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves19
: Didn’t I tell you stay out of-
lines.zh: : 我不是叫你别——

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves20
: Miku...
lines.zh: : Miku……

lines.en: : Maki...Sensei told me where you were but...
lines.zh: : Maki……Sensei 告诉我你们在哪儿,可是……

lines.en: : He wouldn’t tell me what happened...
lines.zh: : 他不肯告诉我发生了什么……
: 这件事……

lines.en: : We can talk later, sweetheart. Makoto needs to-
lines.zh: : 我们晚点再说,亲爱的。Makoto 需要——

lines.en: : Daddy’s gone!
lines.zh: : 爸爸走了!

lines.en: scene fatesealedinradiowaves21
: Makoto, I...
lines.zh: : Makoto,我……

lines.en: : Oh, fuck it. Come join us on the floor. You’re basically my second daughter anyway.
lines.zh: : 唉,管他呢。也到地上来一起吧。反正你基本上就是我第二个女儿了。

lines.en: : Okay...but...ummm...I’m probably gonna cry too...
lines.zh: : 好……可是……嗯……我大概也会哭的……

lines.en: : I really don’t care. She needs all the love she can get right now and I just...
lines.zh: : 我真的无所谓。她现在需要尽可能多的爱,而我只是……

lines.en: : I guess what I have isn’t enough...
lines.zh: : 我想,我能给的还不够……
